entries.name: SHIPSTATION_API_KEY
entries.description: The ShipStation account's API v2 key, for reading shipments and labels. ShipStation has no read-only key: it could also buy and void labels, which the connector never sends. It goes only to ShipStation.
howToGet: In ShipStation, open the API Settings page and generate an API key, as ShipStation's authentication guide describes.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
